errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors and patterns to conditions. The correct mapping is: 'no SFT' (blue with diagonal stripes), '+ SFT on D₀' (yellow with horizontal stripes), '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' (purple with slanted stripes), and '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' (peach with solid fill).

errors.text_span: The 'no SFT' bars for 'LLaMA-2-7B', 'LLaMA-2-13B' and 'LLaMA-2-70B' have approximate values of 22%, 25% and 27% respectively.
errors.evidence: The 'no SFT' bars actually have values of approximately 66%, 70%, and just above 80%, respectively.

errors.text_span: The pink-purple bars representing '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' tend to have the greatest values in each group, reaching a height of approximately 80% for 'LLaMA-2-70B'.
errors.evidence: The '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' bars (peach with solid fill) reach approximately 82% for 'LLaMA-2-7B' and 'LLaMA-2-13B', and close to 80% for 'LLaMA-2-70B'.
